description: Every token fully resolved for each brand and mode. values[brand][mode][token] is the DTCG $value with aliases replaced (dimensions keep their unit; shadows are lists of layers).

color.white.description: Pure white. Light surfaces and text on accent fills.

color.black.description: Pure black. Reserved for shadows and scrims; never a dark-mode canvas.

font.stack.schibsted-grotesk.description: Schibsted Grotesk (OFL; Bakken & Baeck for Schibsted). Sturdy news grotesk with tight apertures; Meridian display.

font.stack.source-sans-3.description: Source Sans 3 (OFL; Paul D. Hunt, Adobe). Humanist sans with wide language coverage; Meridian body.

font.stack.jetbrains-mono.description: JetBrains Mono (OFL). Tall x-height code face; Meridian mono.

font.stack.fraunces.description: Fraunces (OFL; Undercase Type). Soft variable serif with optical size and SOFT/WONK axes; Ember display.

font.stack.figtree.description: Figtree (OFL; Erik Kennedy). Friendly geometric sans with open forms; Ember body.

font.stack.ibm-plex-mono.description: IBM Plex Mono (OFL; Mike Abbink, Bold Monday). Slab-influenced mono; Ember mono.

font.size.xs.description: 12px. Badges, legal, axis labels; never body copy.

font.size.md.description: 16px. Body text and inputs (16px stops iOS zoom on focus).

ease.standard.description: Default for elements moving within the screen.

ease.emphasized-decelerate.description: Hero entrances and large surfaces arriving.

gutter.description: Page side padding: 16px on phones to 32px on desktop.

color.bg.surface.description: Default container: cards, panels, table rows, inputs.

color.bg.surface-raised.description: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts. In dark mode it is lighter than surface (elevation reads as lightness).

color.bg.sunken.description: Recessed wells: code blocks, table headers, disabled inputs, progress tracks.

color.fg.default.description: Body text, headings, icons with meaning.

color.fg.muted.description: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text. Still 4.5:1 (7:1 in high contrast).

color.fg.subtle.description: Placeholders and non-essential text only (3:1). Never for information the user needs.

color.fg.on-accent.description: Text and icons on accent-default, accent-hover and accent-active fills.

color.border.subtle.description: Decorative dividers and card outlines (no contrast requirement).

color.border.default.description: Component borders where the border is not the only cue.

color.border.strong.description: Borders that identify a control (inputs, checkboxes, radio rings): 3:1 on canvas, WCAG 1.4.11.

color.accent.default.description: Primary action fill, selected and checked states, brand moments. Scarce: one primary per view.

color.accent.subtle.description: Tinted background: selected rows, accent badges, highlighted callouts.

color.accent.fg.description: Accent text and icons: links, active navigation. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and accent-subtle.

color.success.fg.description: Success text and icons; 4.5:1 on Success-bg, canvas and surface.

color.warning.fg.description: Warning text and icons; 4.5:1 on Warning-bg, canvas and surface.

color.danger.fg.description: Danger text and icons; 4.5:1 on Danger-bg, canvas and surface.

color.info.fg.description: Info text and icons; 4.5:1 on Info-bg, canvas and surface.

color.focus-ring.description: Focus outline (2px, offset 2px): 3:1 against canvas, surface and raised surfaces.

button.padding-y.description: With 16px text at line-height 1.5 this gives a 40px button.

button.target-min.description: Minimum hit area; extend with padding or a pseudo-element.

input.placeholder.description: Placeholder text; never the only label.

input.border.description: 3:1 so the field boundary is visible (WCAG 1.4.11).

input.border-invalid.description: Pair with an error message and icon.

input.font-size.description: 16px so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus.

focus.ring-offset.description: Gap between the element and its ring.
